channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: ADB chief warns of high inflation in Asia amid uncertainty
item.description: "The global economy is facing unprecedented uncertainty," said Masato Kanda, a former Japanese vice finance minister for international affairs.

item.title: Rakuten sells record ¥400 billion of bonds on retail demand
item.description: The 5.5-year bonds carry a 4.37% coupon and were priced at a spread of 200 basis points over the benchmark 10-year Japanese government bond.

item.title: Power harassment and a possible casino weigh on Yokohama mayoral election
item.description: While Takeharu Yamanaka promised to change his behavior, he has also rekindled the question of, and his opposition to, a potential casino development.

item.title: U.S. holds more secret talks with Myanmar’s military-backed rulers in Tokyo, sources say
item.description: It was their second meeting in a month as Washington steps up reengagement with the generals it shunned after their 2021 coup.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
